speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The basket. Your hands will be free once the pack is down. In with it, before you tell me a road.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The pack is down. The basket is in. Good morning, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good morning is a word. The washing is a fact. Your letters are on the shelf, under Gib. He has kept that shelf, and I will not swear the count of the days.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Under Gib. I will not move him for a letter until he has moved himself.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He will not move, sir. I asked him with the broom, and he took the broom for a courtesy.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: We dine when the loaf is cut, which is when I say. Today I say at noon. If you are in the house you are at the table. If you are in the street you may explain yourself to the loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be at the table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There is a quantity of road on those shoes. I keep a hall, Master Shakespeare, not a highway. You will not grind the miles into my boards and call it coming home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll have them off. The last of it I carried myself, for the look of the thing. A mile and a half. The night was in Carter Lane. Nine hours, and the soundest since Stratford.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I did not ask you where you slept. I asked you to carry the washing, and you have carried it. That is the welcome. The plot of the journey can wait until you have eaten something that did not come out of a wallet.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I take the pack up, sir? The strap looks as if it has been arguing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the strap. It wants shortening, and I am not shortening it on the stair. I'll take the pack up. The look of the last mile was the point of carrying it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. Quiet after nine, as it was before you went. No company man sleeping on my floor without an agreement. No candle down to the socket because a girl in a story will not go to bed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No company man tonight. The candle I will answer for. The girl is not in the house.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is she the one with the moon, sir? Mistress said I was not to ask until the basket was done.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The basket is done, and you are still not to ask it on the stair. Water, Alse. He can be a lodger again when his shoes are not a map.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Letters under Gib. Dinner at noon. Shoes off. I have the order of the house. The road can be a plot at the table, if you want the plot.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I want it as a plot. I always want it as a plot. I do not want it in the hall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then once, at noon. I will not rehearse it on the stair. Nine hours is the night. The shoes are the road. You have both, and I am going up.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Once is a plot. Twice is a rehearsal, and I do not keep a company. Up.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The water is at the top, sir. I did not set it on the book. The book has the cat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the water can sit beside the cat. Thank you, Alse. Mistress, the basket is in the kitchen.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will take the shoes to the step, sir, if you leave them where I can find them without a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On the step. No speech. The plot is for noon, and the shoes are for now.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Noon, then. I will not ask about the road on the stair. Mistress has the order of that.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: As I am a Christian woman, those shoes will be outside before the loaf is cut. Go up. Gib will supervise the shelf. You will not call the cat a greeting.
